name: Augusta, Order Returned

abilities.text: Whenever ~ attacks, each player exiles a card from their graveyard. When one or more nonland cards are exiled this way, put that many +1/+1 counters on target attacking creature.

notes: Each player exiles a card from their own graveyard (`move` of a chosen set with who: each-player, choose: owner, one per player in APNAP order), and the "When one or more nonland cards are exiled this way" clause is the reflexive trigger that follows it (CR 603.12). APPROXIMATION: nothing counts how many of the exiled cards were nonland, so "that many" is written as the number of players (one card per player is exiled, which is the upper bound).

problems: round trip 0.50 < 0.55: "Whenever ~ attacks, each player exiles a card from their graveyard. When one or more nonland cards are exiled this way, put that many +1/+1 counters on target attacking creature." rendered as "whenever ~ attacks, exile a card from each player's graveyard. when you do, put the number of opponents you have plus 1 +1/+1 counters on target attacking creature"
